claim: From 27 Aug 2025 the US added a 25% duty on goods of India (EO 14329, Russian-oil order), on top of the existing 25% reciprocal rate, i.e. 50% in all (the 50% is a sum, calculated).

evidence.quote: articles of India imported into the customs territory of the United States shall be subject to an additional ad valorem rate of duty of 25 percent.

Products of India, except those set forth in section 3 of Executive Order 14329, that are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on August 27, 2025, will be subject to the additional ad valorem rate of duty provided for in new HTSUS heading 9903.01.84.
the United States will lower the Reciprocal Tariff on India from 25% to 18%.

method: 25 + 25 = 50. The 25% reciprocal rate is evidenced only by the fact sheet's wording; EO 14326/14257 text was not opened.
notes: HISTORY ONLY. Both layers have since ended (C302, C303). Do not say '50% now'.

claim: The 25% Russian-oil duty on India ended for goods entered from 7 Feb 2026 (EO 14384); on 20 Feb 2026 EO 14389 ended all IEEPA additional duties, including EO 14257 (reciprocal) and EO 14329 (India oil).

evidence.quote: on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 7, 2026, products of India imported into the United States shall no longer be subject to the

the additional ad valorem duties imposed pursuant to IEEPA in ... Executive Order 14257, as amended; ... Executive Order 14329, as amended; ... shall no longer be in effect and, as soon as practicable, shall no longer be collected.

notes: Why the 50% story is dated. EO 14384 also has a snap-back monitoring clause (Commerce to monitor Russian oil imports); no reimposition seen in documents read.

shall continue in effect through 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July 24, 2026, unless the surcharge imposed in this proclamation is expressly suspended, modified, or terminated on an earlier date, or unless the effective period of such surcharge is extended by an Act of the Congress.

claim: Since 24 Jul 2026 the US applies a Section 301 tariff of 10% on products of India (except Annex I / Annex II Part A items), in addition to the normal duty; notice USTR 91 FR 47318, published 28 Jul 2026.

evidence.quote: the Trade Representative has determined to impose 10 percent tariffs on products of India, except as provided in Annex I and Annex II, Part A, of this Notice.

The additional rates of duty are applicable with respect to products that are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern time on July 24, 2026

all products that are subject to the additional ad valorem rates of duty imposed by these headings shall also be subject to the general rates of duty imposed under subheadings in chapters 1 to 97 of the tariff schedule.

notes: Terms as of 30 Oct 2026 per documents read; recheck on recording day (G5). The 10% rate is the same as for the UK, Canada, Mexico etc. in the same notice.
